prompts.sulfur-ground: Create an original BrineSpace seabed material field using the attached installed coral sediment as the fine-detail, matte painted surface and overhead perspective reference. Fill a square canvas edge to edge with opaque ground, no frame, scene, organisms or large props. Strict orthographic overhead, fine hand-painted mineral grain, restrained contrast and small natural details. This material will span a broad multi-cell habitat underneath 0.3–0.65-cell sprites; keep most ground quiet and avoid oversized focal features, embossed tall rocks, decorative symbols, regular diamonds or bilateral symmetry. Subdued local material color, no underwater blue lighting baked in. The game applies its submerged tint. One irregular continuous field, not a grid of repeated tiles. Sulfur vent silt: warm gray dark sediment with sparse low pale-gray mineral deposits and tiny dull yellow-ochre dust veins. Unequal diffuse patches of powder occupying at most one fifth of the field; broad quiet silt intervals. No luminous yellow pools.
